detail.title: Conditions for Question Abandonment
detail.question: Under what structural conditions should an intellectual framework abandon its foundational questions in favor of more coherent research agendas?
detail.reason: Attention rotation mandates focus on question_abandonment.

children.title: Structural Conditions for Question Abandonment in Research Agendas

detail.title: Structural Conditions for Question Abandonment in Research Agendas
detail.summary: This revision analyzes how established intellectual frameworks, such as sociology, solidify their questions, creating high abandonment costs, and contrasts this with decision-theoretic models of sunk cost that predict persistence even when alternative agendas offer higher potential coherence.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate new evidence on sunk cost effects and intellectual framework hierarchy.
